ROMARR - The Ultimate ROM Automation & Management Tool
A single self-contained container for managing your entire retro gaming library. Built on a proven, production-grade automation stack with no external dependencies.
CORE FEATURES: • Complete Import Pipeline Automated detection and import of completed downloads from any supported client. Handles both single games and full-set archives transparently. • Unified Cataloguing Automatic metadata, artwork, and ROM association. Clean, consistent library out of the box. • Multi-Indexer Search Simultaneous search across all connected indexers. • Direct Client Integration Native support for qBittorrent, Transmission, Deluge, and rTorrent. • External Platform API (v1.0) Cartridge and custom frontends can submit game requests through the native search + grab pipeline. • Built-In Web Interface Full management and browsing UI, served internally on port 8090. • Zero External Services Required No Radarr, No Sonarr, No manual scraping. Everything runs inside.
SUPPORTED PLATFORMS: MAME • FBNEO • CPS1 • CPS2 • CPS3 • GGC • GBA GBA SP • GB • GBC • NDS • NES • SNES • 3DO • PSX PS2 • WII • WiiU • Dreamcast • Saturn • Sega32X Sega CD • Saturn • N64 • Xbox • Jaguar • 3DO PSP • PS1 • PS2 • PS3 • GameCube • GBA SNES • N64 • Genesis/Mega Drive • SMS • Master System
CONFIGURATION GUIDE: 1. DOWNLOAD CLIENT: qBittorrent / Transmission / Deluge / rTorrent • Host: The IP address of your download client on your network. • Port: The port your download client is listening on. • User / Password: API credentials (required for qBittorrent, optional for others). 2. DOWNLOAD WATCHER: • Enable Watcher: Yes (recommended for automatic import). • Download Path: /downloads (standard Unraid path). • LIBRARY: • Library Path: /movies (your Unraid data path). • INDEXERS: Configure any number of indexers in the web UI after first launch. • NOTIFICATIONS: Enable Discord / Telegram / Gotify for real-time download + import alerts.
VERSION: v1.0.0
